name: Historical portfolio reuse across freelancing platforms and company sites

attribution.legal_posture: This is a historical source-attributed research finding with historical status; current sanctions, criminal adjudication, and verified civil identity require separate sources.

caveats: The reporting is historical; present activity, current account control, and knowing participation by every named foreign entity require newer or source-specific evidence.
The sources document platform hopping and portfolio reuse by 2018 in a specific historical network.
Publish as historical TTP context; current detection status requires newer evidence.
Repeated portfolio-artifact reuse and cross-platform account relationships are directly described by both investigations.

statements: The two 2018 investigations found the same or closely related software portfolio artifacts reused across Upwork, Elance, Freelancer.com, Guru.com, social profiles, and a front-company website.
Accounts claimed different names and locations while advertising a consistent specialty set centered on computer vision and mobile/software development.
C4ADS reported that kjg197318-associated programmers completed or were offered 89 Freelancer.com projects involving clients in 35 countries.
limitations: Publish as historical TTP context, not as a current detection indicator.
The sources document platform hopping and portfolio reuse by 2018 in a specific historical network.
